name: FM CHIP
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless 16-bit game music. Six FM channels, PCM drums, a tracker on screen.
description: FM CHIP turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless 16-bit console soundtrack in the style of the Mega Drive / Genesis FM chip. Six four-operator FM channels play slap bass, brass, bells, electric piano and synth leads; 8-bit PCM drums hit underneath. Each song is written as tracker patterns through intro, verse, chorus and bridge, with seventh chords, pushed stabs and busy basslines, loops a few times and ends on a jingle. The screen shows the chip at work: each channel's algorithm and operator envelopes live, drum pads, scrolling patterns. Thirteen games, from Loop De Loop to Last Continue.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
